summary: Persisted report integrity depended on per-process Python hash-seed ordering of a terminal-status set.
impact: The genuine 57-page first final build had all17 evidence guards true, but a new read-only --check process could reject the unchanged source/evidence as a changed fact/input/figure registry. This was fail-closed release availability/integrity, not data leakage, model mutation or an incorrect measured result.
root_cause: req_resolved registered in_=list(REQ_TERMINAL_STATUSES). json.dumps(sort_keys=True) sorts mapping keys, not the order of this list, and Python set iteration differs with PYTHONHASHSEED.

reproduced.lifecycle_trace: probe_registry.py showed identical import/build_state/resolve/guard digests within one process; mismatch was cross-process set-list order, not mutation during a run.

fix.author: Lead
fix.semantics_unchanged: Membership/count, all360 fact values, every evidence gate and model/decoder are unchanged; only deterministic serialized registry ordering changes.

required_release_followup: Fresh complete release test record/logs for corrected source
Truthfully refresh current builder pins in requirement final_evidence without changing historical candidate checkpoints
Normal --final rebuild and a fresh separate-process read-only --check
Exact final PDF/layout/source/output pins before artifact freeze
